title: GPU-only SoA scratch buffers need a generated component-header initializer
body: ExposureMeterState is GPU-only scratch with generated SoA accessors, but no CPU transfer row stamps its component-region header, so BuildRenderGraph.cpp:1930-1971 initializes the header words by hand in a PostCompile hook (offsets re-derived from the manifest, duplicating TransferPlan::Fill's layout loop). One-time per compile, 0 B/frame. The kernel should emit the header initializer (or a GpuOnly transfer row) so no host code recomputes SoA layout. Tier sol: kernel generation model for GPU-only resources.

title: AccumulationHistoryNode re-derives accumulation policy from env beside the AccumulationSettings producer
body: The reset-on-motion counter moved from the deleted AccumulationConfigNode into AccumulationHistoryNode (AccumulationHistoryNode.cpp ResolveAccumulationPolicy), which reads VIXEN_ACCUMULATION_REPROJECT/VIXEN_RESTIR_GATE_DEMO and a fixed maxFrames=256 itself, while the host settings write (BuildRenderGraph.cpp RefreshResolvedLookSettings) is the producer of the same AccumulationSettings record. Two sources for one policy; the counter should read the record (or become a derived value of it). Tier luna: several files, behavior-preserving.

title: Settings transfer upload maps schema identity to buffer node by a hand string switch
body: VulkanGraphApplication::FillSettingsTransferBuffers (VulkanGraphApplication.cpp:839) maps each transfer row's identity kind (state:lighting-settings ...) to its StorageBufferNode through a hand if-chain, and BuildRenderGraph.cpp addSettingsBuffer names each node. The manifest already carries identity and binding; the destination should come from the schema resource registry (SchemaResourceRegistry) so a new settings record needs no host edit. Tier luna.

title: test_b1_occlusion_ab static asserts are red on the lane base
body: A full VIXEN build fails only in test_b1_occlusion_ab.cpp:106/108 (proxyAabbCount must follow the 96-byte base block; B2 PushConstants must be 112 bytes): the generated SDI push block reports offset 100 and the C++ aggregate is 112/128. Red at lane-rbs2 e2c41b6c before this round and unchanged after. Tier haiku/luna: one test's layout expectation vs regenerated SDI.
